old: उन दोनों का माध्यिका क्या है?
new: उन सभी की माध्यिका क्या है?
reason: English: 'What is the median of those?' (8 grades in one list). The Hindi said 'those two' (दोनों), which refers to something that does not exist. 'सभी' = 'all of them'.
status: proposed by Claude; needs confirmation by the Hindi speaker
